am538qs1.baseName: Walplus 150 LED Lights Christmas Tree Foldable Branches - Green - 150 cm
am538qs1.variantName: Walplus 150 LED Lights Christmas Tree Foldable Branches - Green - 150 cm
am538qs1.sourceDescription: This contemporary artificial Christmas tree offers an elegant festive touch to any space. Blending modern design with holiday tradition, it serves as an ideal centerpiece for both indoor and outdoor festivities, emanating a welcoming glow. Sleek Modern Design Highlighting clean lines and minimal ornamentation, this tree resonates with modern aesthetics. Its streamlined silhouette complements contemporary home decor beautifully, creating a stylish yet timeless festive atmosphere. Convenient USB Connectivity: Equipped with a USB connector, this tree allows for versatile power options, ensuring effortless setup without the need for traditional outlets. This ensures flexibility for positioning anywhere at home or outside. Warm White LED Lights: This tree illuminates your space with charming, energy-efficient LED lighting. The soft, warm white glow creates an inviting ambiance, enhancing holiday gatherings whether tucked in a cozy living room or gracing a scenic terrace. Durable PVC &Steel Build: Crafted from premium PVC, this tree showcases lasting resilience while remaining light enough for easy portability. Supporting the tree, a steel frame provides stability, ensuring it withstands seasonal celebrations year after year. Simple Assembly and Maintenance: This product features a streamlined setup requiring just a screwdriver, making quick work of assembly. To maintain its appearance, cover the tree when not in use, protecting it during inclement weather or off-seasons. Product Specifications Colour: Green PVC and plastic and steel Tree height: 150 cm Bottom diameter: 66 cm Stand size: 35 x 35 cm Decorated with pine corns Hinged Branches for Easy Setup Lifelike Tips Snow Flocked Number of PVC tips: 440 Number of pine cones: 23 Number of baubles: 61 Lights type: LED strip lights Lights color: Warm white Lights length: 150 cm Number of LEDs: 150 Distance between LEDs: 10 cm LED flash modes: 8 Power source: USB Batteries Included: No Voltage: 5 V Wattage: 5 W Indoor and sheltered outdoor use Assembly required: Yes Delivery-contains: 1 x Artificial Christmas tree 1 x Foldable stand 1 x LED string light 1 x Peak 20 x 3 cm ball 21 x 4 cm ball 20 x 6 cm ball This product is powered by DC 5V, but the certified 5V USB power source is not included. Higher voltage may cause overheating to occur and may result in damage to the device and the potential risk of overheating and fiire. • By choosing FSC certified products, you are supporting responsible management of the world's forests. This artificial tree is intended exclusively for indoor festive decoration. Assemble the product on a flat, stable surface using the provided stand to prevent tipping, which could cause injury or property damage. Keep this item away from open flames, candles, fireplaces, and space heaters, as synthetic materials can melt or catch fire under extreme heat. If using electric lights, ensure they are safety-certified and do not leave them turned on unattended. This product is not a toy; keep small parts, detachable ornaments, and packaging away from young children and pets to prevent choking or suffocation. Store in a cool, dry place when not in use to ensure long-term structural safety. WALPLUS, Unit 124, Anglesey Business Park, Littleworth Road, Hednesford, WS12 1NR, United Kingd

tj2417w9.sourceDescription: Create an unforgettable Christmas this year for the whole family, with help from this inflatable Christmas decoration from HOMCOM. This large snowman is filled with LED lights, bringing a beautiful glow at night. Made from durable weather-resistant polyester, it can be used safely outside. The supplied guy ropes and ground stakes keep it in place during windy days. Self-inflating when plugged into the mains, it can be set up and disassembled quickly and easily. Bring seasonal cheer into the home for both the children and adults with this fantastic decoration. • Cute snowman design both adults and children will love • Inner LED lights to illuminate softly at night • Durable and weather-resistant polyester shell, with an IP44 rating, for safe outdoor and indoor use • Self-inflates quickly and can be deflated back down easily for storage • Guy ropes and ground stakes included to keep fixed to the ground • Easy to assemble • Type: Snow man greeting • Color: Multi-colored • Material: Polyester • Overall Dimension: 100W x 80D x 182H cm • Height: 1.82m • Power Cord Line Length: 1.8m • Rated Voltage: 220-240V/50Hz, DC 12V/1000mA • Certification: IP44 • Accessary: 1 x electric air pump (0.8A) 4 x tether ropes 7 x ground stakes, 3 x sandbags • Item Label: 844-293V70 NOTE: Please don't place it outdoor in hard rain or snow! Warning: this product is not a toy. Keep away from children unless under adult supervision. Keep away from open flames and heat sources. If powered, disconnect before cleaning or storage and do not use if damaged. Keep batteries away from children and dispose of used batteries safely. MH Star UK Ltd, 1 Northampton Cross Logistics Park, Northampton Cross Road, Northampton, NN4 9FH, United Kingdom

hqs084a8.variantName: Energy Light Bulbs LED Inflatable Santa Christmas Decoration - 6ft
hqs084a8.sourceDescription: Bring the magic of Christmas to life right outside your home with the 6 ft Self-Inflating LED Santa Claus, a cheerful holiday staple that instantly elevates your yard’s festive appeal. Crafted from durable weather-resistant polyester, this jolly Santa features a built-in blower that inflates the figure in under a minute once plugged in—no hassle, no fuss. Illuminated from within by cool-white LEDs, it warmly lights up nightfall with classic charm. Designed for stability with internal sandbags, securing ropes, and stakes, it withstands breezy evenings to stay upright and merry. Safe for both covered outdoor areas and indoor setups—making it adaptable to porches, front lawns, entryways, lounges, and party spaces alike. The inflatable deflates quickly for compact storage, offering space-saving convenience and reusability for many holidays ahead. Dimensions: H 180cm, W 130cm, D 80cm. Power source: Mains-powered IP44, Suitable for: Indoor & outdoor use Comes with Ground Staking Kit with 2 metre of Wire For Plugging Pre-lit. This product is not a toy.
